propositions: Silent mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact) make success indistinguishable from no-op on stdout, causing agents to issue redundant verification reads and misinterpret failures.
Every in-scope mutating verb must emit a standardized confirmation line on stdout for writes and 'no change: <reason>' for idempotent no-ops, without additional store reads.

Global --quiet and --output json flags must be extracted uniformly at the top-level router and applied to all verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with quiet suppressing only text confirmations and --output json nesting outcomes in a structured envelope.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, transition, revert, claim, session-log) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract while preserving all existing information; transition must retain UNBLOCKED ids in its line.
Consumed seam return types (e.g., add_dependency's dict | None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged; confirmations are a parallel output channel only.
Link's REDIRECT redirect record emission must remain byte-identical before and after the change on write and no-op paths and must suppress additional confirmation lines in text mode.
